decisions.reason: As a certified gasketed plate heat exchanger line for HVAC that is very close to the core portfolio, it is likely to remain, although the lack of recent visible evidence modestly raises the withdrawal risk.
The marine box cooler system builds on established marine cooling capabilities and already showed strong market acceptance, so it remains one of the least likely products to be withdrawn.
The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine thermal management strategy well, but with less visible proof of traction than Product B it carries a somewhat higher rationalization risk.

The compact oil cooler is adjacent to the established exchanger business and useful across industries, yet as a newer line with limited visible follow-up it is more exposed to portfolio pruning than the core products.

Finned tubes for air coolers support the broader exchanger and service business, but as a more component-like offer they are comparatively more vulnerable if resources are shifted toward stronger system lines or new development.
